verdict.rationale: Drata is a SaaS compliance platform with a public API and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test workspace or non-production environment. Community suggestions to run the agent in a VM or on a dedicated laptop are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
